parakeet: No matter how hard I wanted to stay in the church, I couldn't overlook this next one. Good principles were overwritten by bad theology. We had good principles, wonderful principles, care, accountability, community, humility. But bad theology kept overriding them like a virus. Care became prayer fixes it, which then delays treatment and practical help. Accountability became submit to authority, which then shields abusers and silences victims. Community became us versus the world, which cultivates isolation and suspicion of outside resources. Humility became absolute and total depravity. This creates permanent moral injury, shame as identity. Stewardship becomes seed faith and prosperity, which leads to financial exploitation and magical thinking. Justice becomes suffer now, heaven later, no cross, no crown, which breeds passivity in the face of fixable harm. Strip out the superstition and the principles work. Care becomes care plans. Accountability becomes transparent processes. Community becomes mutual aid and trained support. Humility becomes teachability, not self hate. Stewardshi becomes budgets and fair wages. Justice becomes action now, not later.
